name: Tomás Pablo Korenblit
summary: A maker drawn to AI safety by wanting to do good for humanity. Finishing my BSc in Data Science, focused on Bayesian inference and ML. I've already authored two papers because I cared about the problem too much to wait to start contributing. I'm always open to chat!

bullets: Working along with a team on a multilingual benchmark for LLM refusal in power-grabbing requests, to be submitted to AAAI 2027
Participating on BlueDot Impact Projects, self-studying ARENA

Built the data layer for the start-up, a 100K-person graph of investors, founders, and companies across the Americas, MENA, and Europe. Enabled warm-intro pathfinding and community detection over the graph
Built an assistant that turns plain English into Cypher, so non-technical users can query the graph directly
Built a RAG platform for creating annotation interfaces for RLHF. Used by thousands of trainers whose work produced training data for the largest AI companies.
Built validation tools and dashboards (Python, Looker) used team-wide. Oversaw output quality of 150+ agents training LLMs
Built a prospect-generation system that increased daily lead capacity 5x and trained a classifier on client profiles to qualify leads (Python, Pandas, PostgreSQL, Scikit-learn)

publications.title: Not All Instructions Are Forgotten Equal
bullets: Do LLMs forget some instructions faster than others? Per instruction effects span more than an order of magnitude where some can fail while mean compliance stays high
Used a Bayesian ordered-logistic model with hierarchical effects, fit in PyMC

publications.title: PowerBench: LLM Refusal in Power-Grabbing Requests
publications.status: Coauthor (6 authors), in preparation for AAAI 2027
bullets: First public benchmark for whether LLMs go along with requests to grab power from others. Varied by model, language, nationality, domain, and scale
